definitions.explanation: To legally end a marriage. In Japan, divorce can be by mutual consent ({協議離婚|きょうぎりこん}), mediation ({調停離婚|ちょうていりこん}), or court ruling ({裁判離婚|さいばんりこん}).

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{離婚|りこん}した。
examples.english: The two of them got divorced.

examples.japanese: ⟦{離婚|りこん}→離婚：02530_rikon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{不一致|ふいっち}→不一致：15246_fuicchi⟧だった。
examples.english: The reason for the divorce was incompatibility.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{離婚|りこん}することになった。
examples.english: They ended up divorcing after three years of marriage.

notes:
Compound of {離|り} (separate) + {婚|こん} (marriage). In Japan, the most common form is ⟦{協議|きょうぎ}→協議：02635_kyougi⟧⟦{離婚|りこん}→離婚：02530_rikon⟧ (divorce by mutual agreement), which requires only submitting a form to the local government office — no court involvement needed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{離婚|りこん}→離婚：02530_rikon⟧{届|とどけ}: divorce registration form
- ⟦{離婚|りこん}→離婚：02530_rikon⟧⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧: divorce rate
- ⟦{離婚|りこん}→離婚：02530_rikon⟧⟦{訴訟|そしょう}→訴訟：07642_soshou⟧: divorce lawsuit
- ⟦{協議|きょうぎ}→協議：02635_kyougi⟧⟦{離婚|りこん}→離婚：02530_rikon⟧: divorce by mutual consent
- ⟦{離婚|りこん}→離婚：02530_rikon⟧⟦{慰謝料|いしゃりょう}→慰謝料：14802_isharyou⟧: divorce alimony/consolation money

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan's divorce system allows couples to divorce simply by mutual agreement and submitting a {離婚届|りこんとどけ} (divorce form) to the city office. This {協議離婚|きょうぎりこん} accounts for about 90% of all divorces in Japan.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to marry (the opposite)
- ⟦{別居|べっきょ}→別居：11879_bekkyo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to live apart, to separate (without legally divorcing)
- ⟦{再婚|さいこん}する→再婚する：25476_saikonsuru⟧: to remarry
